book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Rau Tau Paulus Iboode Pa Timoti Imin Maata 1 Timoti—1 Timothy

content: Saa ŋgar tau iit irau tagham pa Maaron tamtamon tooni

Matam iŋgal. Isaav ighe upaduduuŋ tamtamon pa eez to Krisi, na uŋaar zolmana sov. Utandagh pazi, ve usavia saveeŋ pazi toman roroniiŋ, imin yo usavsaav pa taum tamam. Ve usaav pa zitamoot paghpaaghu imin tau usavsaav pa tazimŋa.
Ve zolman tinazi, ugham ŋgar pazi raraate imin tau ughamgham pa tinam na. Ve yes zilivaa paghpaaghu paam, ugham ŋgar ŋgalaaŋa mon pazi imin tau ughamgham pa livumŋa.
Saveeŋ siriv iŋarui zinaara
Zinaara tau zigazi kat na, uroron pazi, ve uŋgin poghani zi.

Eemon isaav ighe naar eta natŋa ma timŋa siriv tilepleep, na ŋgar tau Maaron ighe tighamu imin maata, ene vene: Yes irau timuuŋ pa uleeŋ naar tana. Pasaa, yesŋa siŋ eemon. Leso tiyol mulin besooŋ tau muuŋ tamazŋa ve tinazŋa tigham pazi na, ve titotoi tauzi tighe yes titaghon eez to Maaron. Ŋgar tauvene, ene poia ila Maaron maata.
Yes zinaara tau zigazi kat ve lezi tamtamon eta to iuul zi mako na, tighurghur matazi pa Maaron mon to iuul zi, ve tisuŋsuŋ pani irau mboŋ ve mataaz.
Ve isaav ighe naar eta tiini ibees pa lepoogh poia to taan mon, onoon, i ileep maata yaryaare. Eemon ghuruuŋ ila tooni, ene imaat wa.
Saveeŋ tsiau tane, yo irau avom iyaryaaŋ pani. Leso laghooŋ to zinaara toit iduduuŋ mon ila tamtamon matazi, ve irau tiyau avozi pazi sov.

Isaav ighe tamtamon eta ighe i ighur ila to Maaron, eemon i iuluul tauu siŋ tooni, ma yes tau tileep tomania ila ruum tooni na mako, ene i ighur muuri pa ghuruuŋ ila tooni wa. Ŋgar tauvene, saghati kat. Iliiv sosor to yes tau tighur ila to Maaron mako na.
Isaav ighe yo ughe ughur naar eta eeza ila rau to uleeŋ,

na ugabiiz poghania ŋgar tooni. Le isov, o ughur eeza ila rau, ve lupuuŋ to Krisi tiŋgini pa lepoogh tooni. Ughita yes zinaara tau ndaman toozi irau tamoot tol ve izala. Ve muuŋ, tighur boog mako, ve tilepleep duduuŋ tomania azuwazŋa mon.
Ve varuzi poia pa uraat popoia tau tighamghamu na. Ve muuŋ, tiŋgin poghania natuzŋa ve yes loomba. Ve titatan tauzi, ve tinizi ibees pa uraat to uleeŋ Maaron tamtamon tooni,
ve tiuluul yes tau pataŋani indeeŋ zi na, ve tipul tauzi kat pa uraat popoia maata maata. Zinaara tauvene, o ughur ezazi ila rau to uleeŋ.

Eemon yes zinaara tau paghpaghuzi na, ughur ezazi ila rau to uleeŋ sov. Pa murei, isaav ighe ghaara toozi ipazaagh zi pa vaiŋ muul, ene pale tighur murizi pa Krisi, ve tireu saveeŋ mbuaaŋ toozi, ve tisosor ila Maaron maata.
Ve gabua ite paam. Pale timin tapirgomŋa, ve tirou irau ruum aavo aavo, ve tisinai tamtamon, ve tiseŋgeen saveeŋ pa zetazŋa. Ve tisavia saveeŋ siriv paam tau poia to tasavia mako.
Tauvene yau nagham ŋgar naghe yes zinaara paghpaaghu tivai muul, ve tipoop, ve tiŋgin poghania tauzi ruum toozi, o poia. Leso lezi sosor eta ila koiaanŋa matazi sov, ve irau tiyau avozi pait mako.
Saveeŋ tsiau tane, yau nasavia sorok mako. Pasaa, zinaara siriv, yes tipul eez to Krisi, ve titaghon Sadan ŋgar tooni wa.
Isaav ighe livaa eta ighur ila to Krisi, ve siŋ tooni siriv timin zinaara, i aat iuul zi. Leso tigham pataŋani pa lupuuŋ to Krisi sov, ve lupuuŋ irau iuul yes zinaara tau zigazi kat.
Ŋgar tau lupuuŋ to Krisi irau tigham pa yes ŋginiiŋa

Yes ŋginiiŋa tau tiŋgin poghania lupuuŋ to Krisi na, yam irau atandagh pazi ve agham lezi atuya poia. Ve yes ŋginiiŋa tau tighamgham uraat tiina pa votiaaŋ Maaron aliiŋa ve tipaghazoŋai gham pani, o atandagh pazi kat, ve agham lezi atuya tiina rig.
Pasaa, Maaron aliiŋa tau tiboode na isaav tauvene:

content.text: “Bapolo tau ivavaghaaz wit tsio na, upoon aavo sov. Leso ighan le aniiŋ siriv.”

content: Ve saveeŋ ziiri ite isaav ighe:

content.text: “Tamtamon tau ighe igham uraat, ene i aat igham le atuya.”

content: Isaav ighe tamtamon eemon iŋgal saveeŋ pa ŋginiiŋ eta, na ulooŋa sov. Ve isaav ighe tamtamon ru, ma tol tipariaaŋ saveeŋ raraate, o ulooŋ zi.
Yes ŋginiiŋa tau tinoknok ghamuuŋ sosor na, uvotia sosor toozi ila eval tiina matazi, ve uyaon zi. Leso yes siriv tighita ve tiroi.

Timoti, Maaron yesuru Naatu Yesu Krisi ve yes aŋela tau Maaron ighur zi pa uraat tooni na, yau nasaav ariaaŋ payo ila matazi tauvene: Saveeŋ tsiau isov tane, matam kisini ve utaghon duduŋaini. Ve yo aat ugham ŋgar raraate mon pa tamtamon tisov. Uvool to eta sov.
Ughur nimam izala tamtamon pavozi ve ughur zi timin ŋginiiŋa rekia sov. Ve upaak tamtamon pa sosor toozi sov. Uŋgin taum poi, leso gabuam isov iŋgalaaŋ ila Maaron maata.
Yau nawatagh: Yo lem moroghooŋ igheen ila apom, ve monmon ighamgham ghom. Tauvene yo irau ughun yaa mon mako. Ughun vaen rig paam, o poia. Leso iuul ghom.

Tamtamon siriv, ŋgar toozi sasaghati igheen ghazooŋa. Tauvene rekia mon ve taghilaal zi taghe murei Maaron pale ighur atuya pazi. Ve tamtamon siriv, ŋgar toozi sasaghati iyooŋ. Eemon yes paam, murei pale tigham atuya to ŋgar toozi sasaghati tawe.
Ŋgar popoia tau tamtamon tigham zi na, tauvene paam. Siriv igheen ghazooŋa. Ve siriv mako. Eemon irau iyooŋ taghon taghon gha ila ne mako. Murei pale ivot ighazooŋ.

footnotes.text: Zeran ŋgara siriv tighe mos ziiri tane iŋarui yes zinaara tau timbu saveeŋ tighe yes irau tivai muul mako, ve tigham uraat to Maaron mon. Yes tau timbu saveeŋ tauvene, mako tighur ezazi ila rau to uleeŋ, leso lupuuŋ to Krisi tiuul zi, ve tiŋgin zi pa lepoogh toozi.
Saveeŋ tau Paulus iboode na, isaav tauvene: “Yes timinmin Maaron tamtamon tooni aghezi.” Saveeŋ tane iŋarui uraat maata maata to uleeŋ.
